claimBoundary: The experiment uses the same raw-component 64x64 4:2:0 synthetic signal as the iMCU context study, separately encoded as baseline and progressive JPEG. It compares ImageIO direct image creation against a full-size thumbnail request, with kCGImageSourceShouldAllowFloat both disabled and enabled.

Every variant is rendered into the same explicit top-to-bottom sRGB RGBA8 buffer before comparison. The formal claim is byte identity between API-path variants for each coding mode; any difference fails the experiment rather than being averaged into a tolerance.

Passing this experiment only rules out these public ImageIO API/allow-float switches as a workaround for the observed raster difference on the generated domain. It does not prove that every ImageIO option, OS release, decode scale or pixel representation shares the same internal path.
